risk_note: RV2 payout (withdraw lane B2-06fz; model Claude Fable 5.1). Orchestrator rulings D10-326 (option C) / D10-327 / D10-332: the payout process connects as couli_payout, which has no grant on the ledger or users tables, so W5 / W6 (status transition + voucher) move to the worker. Payout side (transfer-job / query-job): a success / fail result is recorded on the attempt row (response carries raw, kind, status, channel_order_id, paid_at, received_at = the Clock when the result came back) and, on the same couli_payout transaction, the withdrawal is re-read: still PAYING, same execute_seq and row_version as first read, needs_manual false → queue.send('payout-landing', 'land', { app_id, withdrawal_id, execute_seq, attempt_id }, singletonKey `${withdrawal_id}:${execute_seq}:land:${attempt_id}`); otherwise only logger.warn('payout_landing_skipped') and W10 ends it (the B2-06d / 06e CAS-miss rule tests stay unchanged). payer_side stays W9 in the payout process and is never handed over; unknown, W9, needs_manual and the query points are unchanged. Worker side (jobs/landing-job.ts, registered by PayoutModule.forWorker on the new worker queue payout-landing, exclusive, concurrency 1): ① unlocked read for user_id → identity's lockUsersForUpdate → withdrawal FOR NO KEY UPDATE; missing / another app / not PAYING / other execute_seq / needs_manual → info, nothing written; ② the attempt row must be this withdrawal's with response.kind ∈ {success, fail} equal to its result column, else warn, nothing written; ③ W5 / W6 through application/payout-landing.ts on that transaction (CAS on row_version; paid_at = channel time → response.received_at → attempt.at; fail_code = resp_sub_code → response.status → resp_code; voucher WITHDRAW:SUCCESS:CASH_<channel> / WITHDRAW:RETURN; wallet.withdrawal_changed). A redelivery or a second landing job of the same withdrawal ends at ① once it left PAYING: one voucher. The B2-06d / 06e rule tests are unchanged on disk; their fixtures' transferJob / queryJob now run the worker's landing handler after the payout handler (auto-land) so every result / voucher / idempotency assertion keeps its meaning; the P→A hand-off itself is pinned in test/spec/payout/landing/handoff.int.test.ts. Amounts are bigint fen through @couli/money (landing); instants only from the injected Clock; logs carry ids, codes and attempt ids, never the payee. Handover (orchestrator 2026-10-26 20:3x): original author withdraw lane (account 4, paused to 10-30; head f3b55ea5 stacked on B2-06a / B2-06b); taken over by admin-backend, which took the task's own commits unchanged onto main after B2-06a #1387 (B2-06b already merged as #1462), resolved additive conflicts only, and re-ran the red run and the full verification on the test machine. Reviews were not re-run: the task's code and tests are the reviewed ones. Handover (orchestrator 2026-10-26 20:3x; D10-370 / D10-376): original author withdraw lane (head f3b55ea5 on the 10-24 main); taken over by admin-backend, which rebuilt the rule tests and the queue registration on the latest main as recorded under spec_test_review and reviews; full verification on the test machine verify/4 exit 0 (PROP_RUNS=2000 as in CI test:int).
